crossRefs.note: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent…
you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service…
Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and…
Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good…
No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on…

translations.web: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.
translations.bsb: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting.
translations.kjv: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.asv: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth upon the service, to do the work of the tent of meeting.
